Neutral theory of molecular evolution.value: Neutral theory debate still active 2024-2026: PMC10839204 'Half a Century of Controversy: The Neutralist/Selectionist Debate in Molecular Evolution' (Genome Biology and Evolution 2024); Biological Reviews (de Jong et al. 2024) re-examines which specific propositions are contested. Neutral theory remains the standard null model but selective pressures on more genomic regions are being documented.

EES (Extended Evolutionary Synthesis) Royal Society meeting, 7-9 November 2016, London; 300 scientists evaluated proposed extensions; papers published Interface Focus 2017. Active debate 2024-2026 over sufficiency of Modern Synthesis vs EES incorporating epigenetic inheritance, developmental plasticity, niche construction.
